summary: End-to-end tested the two new features: Report Replies and SOS Emergency Button. Backend pytest (test_report_reply_sos.py): 13 passed, 1 xfailed. Covered: /api/dates/report/{bid}/reply — reporter 403, min-details 400, 404 missing booking, happy path with photo upload (/api/upload) + GET verify in Mongo + reply.photos stored, duplicate 409 ALREADY_REPLIED; private file access on the reply photo — anon 403, owner (reported user) 200, admin 200; SOS — auth required, invalid coords 400, happy path without coords (lat/lng null, status open), happy path with coords; admin SOS — non-admin 403, admin lists alert, admin resolve 200 then 404 on repeat, DB status flips to resolved. The xfail documents that the backend sos_alert endpoint does NOT auto-enable live_location sharing with support (frontend LiveLocation.jsx handles that via a follow-up POST /live-location, which was verified in the browser flow). Frontend Playwright: logged in as ll_tester via token injection (gd_token in localStorage), /dates shows reported-block-ll-test-1 with reasons + original details, reply-open-ll-test-1 opens reply-form-ll-test-1 (0 reason chips, details textarea, photo-add, photo-input, submit), after submit reply-sent-ll-test-1 appears and toast 'SOS sent/Reply sent' shows. sos-block-ll-test-1 and sos-btn-ll-test-1 render inside the live-location card; clicking triggers POST /api/sos/booking/ll-test-1 and TWO POST /api/live-location/booking/ll-test-1 calls (auto-share with support, matching the spec); 'SOS sent' toast visible. Admin at /admin > Dates tab shows admin-booking-reply-ll-test-1 with the exact reply text; Admin > Live locations shows admin-sos-{id} card with map and admin-sos-resolve-{id} — clicking the resolve button removes the card and shows 'Marked resolved' toast. Seed data (ll-test-1 open report, no reply; rp-test-2 started) restored at the end.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/sos/{kind}/{did} does NOT itself set live_location.{uid}.to_support=true server-side; the auto-sharing promise relies entirely on the frontend making a second POST /live-location/... call. If a non-browser client (or a user who denies geolocation) presses SOS, support will NOT see them on the live-locations map. Consider having sos_alert flip to_support=true (and persist last-known coords if provided) atomically in the booking's live_location map so the admin tab shows them even without the frontend follow-up.

/api/dates (list_dates) returns the raw booking.report dict for both parties, including the nested report.reply.details and report.reply.photos. The reporter can therefore read the reported person's reply text and private-photo storage paths via /api/dates even though the UI hides it. _report_view() exists specifically to sanitize what each viewer sees — route list_dates through it (or strip report.reply for the reporter) to actually enforce the privacy intent.
server.py is now ~5.2k LOC; splitting dates/bookings/admin/sos into separate routers remains advisable.
InviteDates POST /invites/{did}/report still has no ALREADY_REPORTED guard (previously flagged in iteration_9).
